title: Beam with two loaded overhangs: moment in the middle portion and midspan deflection - values printed by the vendor that do not reproduce

source.work: ANSYS, Inc., Mechanical APDL Verification Manual (public help site ansyshelp.ansys.com)
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text; the sketch was not readable). The page cites: Timoshenko, Strength of Materials, Part I, 3rd ed. 1955, p. 98, problem 4 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'Target' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Beam of 480 in on two supports 240 in apart, with two overhangs of 120 in; 10,000 lb/ft downward on both overhangs only; A = 50.65 in^2, Iz = 7892 in^4, depth 30 in, E = 30e6 psi. First-order analysis without shear deformation. The page prints the bending stress in the middle portion (compression at the bottom); the target here is the bending moment = stress x Iz / (depth / 2) = stress x 526.1333 in^3. Same model as problem 'vm2-beam-with-overhangs' (whose recomputed targets are active); the targets here are the vendor's printed values only.

targets.precisionNote: printed "11400.000" x 526.133333333 (unit conversion / common factor of the source); tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; printed bending stress in psi (printed negative, at the bottom flange)
targets.sign: hogging in the middle portion: negative Mz (local y up)

quarantine.diagnosis: Missed by 3.5e-4 relative: engine moment -6,000,000 lb in, i.e. a stress of -11,403.95 psi; printed target -11400.000 psi. The page prints a value rounded to three significant figures (evidently the textbook's rounded answer) with three decimals, so the printed-precision rule assigns it the floor tolerance 1e-6, which its real precision (5e-3 x 11,400 ... half a unit of the third figure) does not support. The exact value follows from statics: the moment in the middle portion is w a^2 / 2 = (10000/12) x 120^2 / 2 = 6.0e6 lb in, the stress 6.0e6 x 15 / 7892 = 11,403.95 psi (ODE oracle = engine to 1e-15). The page's deflection target (0.182 in) reproduces and is a target of the active problem.
